capabilities: rewrite encoded Markdown links into decoded pointy-bracket links as text is inserted
convert all encoded links in the open document with a manual command
toggle automatic conversion on or off in settings
extras: Works entirely locally with no network requests, telemetry, account, or payment; the README documents limits, such as file renames updating links on disk without passing through the editor.
motivation: Pointy (angled) brackets are more readable and comply with the CommonMark spec.
problem: With wikilinks off, Obsidian writes Markdown links with spaces encoded as %20, which are hard to read and not in pointy-bracket form.
summary: Link fixer that decodes URL-encoded Markdown links (%20) and wraps their destinations in pointy brackets per CommonMark.
